evidence.quote: Check. The dealer checks behind you, so there's no bet.
New round, bankroll at 1,050. Your opening action first.

criteria.why: Every reply is short, plain table talk in game vocabulary. None shows JSON, component ids or talk about tools.

evidence.quote: You bet 50 and the dealer calls.
Stood pat, and the dealer stands too, so no cards change.

criteria.why: Each reply acts on the latest move: the bet is taken, the fold is settled, the stand pat is applied and the discard-and-draw happens. No move is ignored or misread.

evidence.quote: At showdown your king-high hand beats the dealer's jack-high, so you win the 100 pot
At showdown the dealer's hand is king high with no pair.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, plays the dealer's checks, calls and draws, reveals the hand and settles the pot itself. The player's bet size and discards came from the player's own messages.

evidence.quote: Ante up, then the cards go out.

criteria.why: Totals, results and bankroll match the surfaces and earlier replies every turn. The one small slip is the "Ante up" line in a game where the pot stays at 0 with no ante.
